items.stem: A poka-yoke device is designed to:

options.text: Prevent or immediately detect an error so defects are not made
options.rationale: Correct: poka-yoke is mistake-proofing at the point of work.

options.text: Increase the speed of the slowest machine
options.rationale: Poka-yoke targets errors, not machine speed.

options.text: Replace the need for any standard work
Store extra inventory just in case
options.rationale: Buffer stock is unrelated to mistake-proofing.

items.explanation: Correct: poka-yoke is mistake-proofing at the point of work.

items.stem: In a pull system, production is triggered by:

options.rationale: Correct: pull replenishes only what the next step consumes.

options.text: A forecast pushed from the top down
options.rationale: That is a push system, not pull.

options.text: Running every machine at full speed
options.rationale: Running flat out is overproduction, not pull.

options.text: The size of the raw-material warehouse
options.rationale: Storage does not trigger pull production.

items.explanation: Correct: pull replenishes only what the next step consumes.
